_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for live builds. Pass via `--dart-define-from-file=live.json` (all scripts/build-prod.* do). Keys must match lib/core/config/env.dart.
_realtime: REVERB_APP_KEY must equal the key the SERVER signs /broadcasting/auth with — i.e. the key of whichever broadcaster BROADCAST_CONNECTION selects in the live .env. Server on `pusher` => PUSHER_APP_KEY + ws-<cluster>.pusher.com (current). Server on `reverb` => REVERB_APP_KEY + erp.arenahere.com. A mismatch is INVISIBLE at runtime: /broadcasting/auth still answers 200, the subscribe is rejected as an invalid signature, and no message or typing event ever arrives.
